questions.question: Write atleast two argument forms for the following / a. p →( q.r) ∴ ~(q.r) →~p b. p →( q V r) p →~q ∴ p V r c. ( p V q) → ( p. q) p.q ∴ p V q
questions.solution_html:
• p→(q.r)
  • ∴~(q.r) →~p
  • Conditional form: If p implies (q.r), then not (q.r)implies not p
  • Contraceptive form (~(q.r) →~p) is the contraceptive of (p→(q.r))
questions.final_answer: Contraceptive form (~(q.r) →~p) is the contraceptive of (p→(q.r))
